Fixed by making T036 -- the mirror/regeneration verification row, which is exactly RS-004's subject -- quote FR-016 on its single line and state FR-016's boundary there (one classification file, one machine gate, no new directory root). G1 then went decision=fail errors=1 -> decision=pass errors=0 with 123 advisories, one more than before because T036 now cites one more to-be-created path. The tags were removed and the reason written into the Format section; the alternative fixes -- re-forming committed contracts, or quoting the tag in a fence so the validator passes while coverage accounting cannot see it -- were both rejected.
